The '''Death Wind Corridor''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] through an area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|The Cloak of the Sith]].

==History==
Because of navigational hazards there were only two [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes into the area. The more popular of the two routes was the [[Manda-Roon Merchant Route]]; the other was the more secret Death Wind Corridor. This route was the "back door" into the area, the Corridor traveled through the worlds of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. The latter planet was notorious for its use as a staging area for [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that were smuggling [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]. Because of the Corridor's importance in ryll distribution, it was frequently the subject of interest for many underworld figures, especially the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].

It consisted one of the three sides of the infamous [[Spice Triangle/Legends|Spice Triangle]] (with the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]).<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
